high.title: 10 Stocks to Invest and Outperform the Ibovespa in April, According to Safra
high.summary: Banco Safra has adjusted its recommended equity portfolio for April, replacing Allos (ALOS3) with Multiplan (MULT3) and rebalancing weights across assets. The bank maintains positive assessments for all portfolio names, with changes driven only by marginal risk-return adjustments. Multiplan's inclusion follows recent underperformance versus peers, creating a more attractive valuation window according to Safra. The company benefits from a leaner capex plan and should be among the main beneficiaries of tax reform in its sector. Notably, Safra reduced Bradesco (BBDC4) weighting due to marginal deterioration in the domestic banking environment, particularly in the credit segment amid rising judicial recovery requests. Conversely, Vale (VALE3) exposure was increased after recent weaker performance. This portfolio adjustment reflects selective positioning within Brazilian equities, with particular attention to banking sector headwinds and commodity sector opportunities, providing insight into institutional sentiment toward key Ibovespa components.
